Description.Name: Bakeneko
Description.Details: The product of a hybrid of Clan and Inner Sphere technology, the 'Mech benefits significantly from its dual heritage. Using a Clan-built 330-rated extralight engine and an Inner Sphere endo steel chassis, the Bakeneko was able carry a large array of weapons and equipment while maintaining a decent top speed of 97.2 km/h. It was also fitted with MASC, giving it crucial bursts of extra acceleration, and its six jump jets allowed it to leap up to 180 meters. The Bakeneko's main weaponry comes from an arm-mounted Clan produced large pulse laser and a light PPC, enhanced with a PPC capacitor. Additionally, found in the 'Mech's side torsos are a pair of MML-3s, each supplied by a ton of ammunition, providing supplemental firepower at long and short ranges, while at short ranges a head-mounted ER medium laser provides additional firepower. Protecting the design from enemy fire, the chassis was fitted with 11.5 tons of standard armor, with Clan CASE installed to mitigate any explosive detonations from its ammunition and PPC capacitor. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

YangsThoughts: The Bakeneko is a medium BattleMech originally created by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat at the dawn of the thirty-second century in a collaboration between Clan Nova Cat scientists and engineers from LAW. Based on the Phoenix Hawk, this slightly bigger design was intended as a fire support and skirmisher unit with the same mobility of the older design. The 'Mech was put into production in early 3100, where it was deployed to both Clan Nova Cat and the DCMS' Eleventh Ghost and Fifth Sword of Light Regiments during the last year of the Second Combine-Dominion War prior to the invasion of Irece in June, 3100. During the invasion, the greatly expanded factories which housed the Bakeneko's production lines were destroyed. The Bakeneko had a reputation as an effective fighting machine, as it was credited numerous kills by Draconis Combine forces during the conflict.
